facts.text: What is stopping goods from reaching Brandonsford? Bentley says his restocking shipment is a week overdue, and Gill says nothing has come into town in months.

classification.grounding_justification: Two townsfolk report overdue and absent shipments, and this Session again notes shipments still haven't come in.
classification.investigative_depth_justification: The answer would reveal an underlying cause cutting the town off, possibly tied to wider dangers.
classification.narrative_payoff_justification: Explaining months of missing goods would reveal a hidden circumstance affecting the whole town.
classification.investigative_potential_justification: Merchants, the trade route and townsfolk could all be questioned or followed as leads.
